title: Hot Spicy Korean Tamarind Skewers
description: A funky and springy Korean dish from Busan featuring tamarind balls, this recipe is ayurvedic-rajasic-friendly and perfect for showing off at any gathering.

ingredients.name: tofu
ingredients.notes: extra-firm, drained and cut into bite-sized pieces

instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Mix tamarind paste, gochujang, brown sugar, rice vinegar, garlic, and ginger in a bowl to create the marinade.
Add the tofu to the marinade and toss to coat.
Thread the marinated tofu onto the bamboo skewers.
Brush the skewers with sesame oil.
Place the skewers on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake the skewers in the oven for 20 minutes, flipping halfway through.
Remove the skewers from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before serving.
